title: The Quiet Battlefield
text: An old battlefield, very still, the grass grown over the bones. A sword stands upright in the middle of it with a ring of clean ground around it where nothing grows. A voice on the wind asks who fought best among you.

options.label: The one with the most kills steps up to claim the sword.

outcomes.text: The sword comes free in their hand, and the wind sighs, satisfied.

options.label: The one who has saved the most lives steps up, and calls that the better fighting.

outcomes.text: The sword stays put. The wind says this was the right answer anyway, and something settles in them.

options.label: Say nothing. The dead can judge for themselves.

outcomes.text: The wind waits a long time, then gives up. The field's dead walk behind you a while, like an honour guard.

options.label: The Sword Saint answers the voice, as one who has given their life to the blade.

outcomes.text: The sword in the ring comes out of the ground for them. It wants to fight again.
The sword comes out of the ground, and the field's dead come with it, to see if the answer was true.
